interpretation: This packet records first-party source observations for reviewer use. It does not approve an authority, opportunity, eligibility rule, benefit, window, or publication status.
sourcePolicy: Official Special Economic Zones portal and Department of Commerce sources only; third-party claims are excluded.

supportingSources.anchor: Application in Form-A, State Government and Board of Approval route, Development Commissioner inspection and notification process
Current SEZ Rules and Amendments page, including 2026 amendments
2026 instructions and current SEZ-Online/user-charge and compliance notices

records.sourceAnchor: Unit facilities, duty-free import/domestic procurement, zero-rated supplies and single-window clearance; Section 10AA sunset note
observations: The official SEZ portal describes duty-free import/domestic procurement for development, operation and maintenance of SEZ units and single-window clearance for Central and State approvals.

The official facilities page states that supplies to SEZs are zero-rated under the IGST Act, 2017, while the historic Section 10AA income-tax benefit is subject to a sunset clause and must not be presented as a current universal tax entitlement.

The official application route is a regulatory approval and unit-operation process involving Form-A, the concerned State Government, the Board of Approval, and the Development Commissioner; it is not a generic grant application.
The official rules and instructions pages show continuing amendments and operational instructions, so the record needs change detection and current amendment review before publication.
reviewFollowUps: Separate unit approval, authorized operations, developer benefits, tax treatment and GST treatment into distinct benefit and requirement records.
Verify the current unit eligibility, positive Net Foreign Exchange, Letter of Approval, authorized-operations and monitoring obligations from the applicable SEZ Act/Rules and current instructions.
Reconcile the Section 10AA sunset language and withdrawn MAT/CST/service-tax statements so historical benefits cannot appear current.
Confirm the current Form-A, SEZ-Online charges, State/Development Commissioner route, documents and any 2026 amendment affecting the unit workflow.

publicationGuard.reason: External source cross-check is not a substitute for the persisted reviewer checklist, complete evidence capture, and authorized publication decision.
